preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array for each test case.
Each element of the array is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: output is either -1 or a sequence of operations
postconditions.description: The output should indicate whether a sequence of operations exists to make all elements of the array equal, and if so, the sequence of operations.

invariants.expression: no operation increases the number of operations beyond 3n
invariants.description: The number of operations performed must not exceed 3 times the number of elements in the array.

invariants.expression: all elements of the array are non-negative after each operation
invariants.description: After each operation, the elements of the array must remain non-negative.
